title: Silk stroke vs fab minimums
hypothesis: Raising every silkscreen stroke (own text/lines and footprint silk) from 0.12 to 0.15 mm, keeping text height 0.8 mm, makes the silk meet PCBWay/Elecrow/Seeed Fusion minimums (and JLCPCB high-precision) without changing copper, drill or mask
expected: F.Silk/B.Silk gerber stroke min >= 0.15 mm; copper, mask, edge, drill gerbers byte-identical apart from timestamps; DRC 0; check_board OK with pad/silk margin 0.15 mm
method: gen_pcb.py silk width constant + footprint silk width override; make_board --reuse-routes; make_fabrication; compare file hashes with the 4973aba gerbers; verify_gerbers; gerbonara stroke histogram
fail: copper/drill differ, DRC != 0, labels no longer fit (J1/J2 band) => try JEDGE/row gaps; else REVERT and document JLCPCB high-precision option instead
